summary: Candidate for Principal/Trader, Total Portfolio Management with ~7 years across cross-asset portfolio analytics, fixed income and FX derivatives validation, liability hedging analysis, and institutional pension ALM. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement) at Moody's Analytics; former pension ALM/LDI advisor at Ortec Finance. Builds Python and SQL analytics pipelines; has deployed AI-enabled workflows to accelerate modelling and validation cycles. CFA charterholder, dual MSc (Financial Modelling; Chemical Engineering).
core_skills: AI-Enabled Analytics Tooling (Claude Code, Cursor IDE)

sections.heading: Cross-Asset Derivatives & Rate-Risk Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio-risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5–25bn per engagement — independently review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Review and validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation products — verify consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates for pension and insurance mandates.
Oversee duration and rate-shock analysis under parallel and non-parallel scenarios, informing hedging and portfolio-construction review for institutional fixed-income mandates.

sections.heading: Liability Hedging, Liquidity & Cash-Flow Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity and funded-status visibility across long-dated horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity-gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) to support funding, refinancing, and asset-allocation analysis for cross-asset institutional mandates.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into projection models aligned with liability-hedging and contingency-planning requirements.

sections.heading: AI-Enabled Tooling & Python Pipeline Development
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls — deployed across the modelling team.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reduced development cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

Prepared analytical summaries for Heads of Risk and senior stakeholders on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities — supporting risk management decisions across multi-asset mandates.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe multi-asset analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and portfolio configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development functions — translated portfolio-team requirements into scoped Product Owner requests.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and implementation materials.

Delivered ALM and LDI studies for Canadian and international pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk to support portfolio construction and liability-hedging decisions.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing rate, inflation, and currency risk under base-case and stressed environments.

Conducted cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across rate, inflation, and currency exposures for international institutional clients; advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs via stress and sensitivity analysis.

Presented ALM and portfolio findings to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients; led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (jointly-sponsored plan) evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
